summary: v4 correctly removes invented preview digests, adds the required truncation/artifactRefs names, honestly parks produced fixtures, and splits the Coverage negative onto ID-DEP-S2. Acceptance still fails at one blocker and one SHOULD-FIX: the operative native map is unchanged and the tagged variants do not replace the contradictory legacy input schema, while two normative references still point at the removed FC-NONAUTH ID.

blockers.title: The claimed native-map repair is absent and the new tagged input variants do not replace the contradictory legacy input schema
detail: machineSurface.nativeMappings is structurally unchanged from v3. It still says one URI maps to 'result.locations[].physicalLocation.artifactLocation.uri and result.relatedLocations[]' and still supplies neither a related-location URI path nor a placement rule. The claimed relatedLocationUri per-entry NFC path appears only in honestyRepairsFromV3; no such member or rule exists in the operative map.

goldenShape.input also remains unchanged from v3: it still requires hostCanonicalResult, advertisement, and dr006Standing, has no variant property, and has no oneOf/discriminator connecting it to inputNotProduced/inputProduced. Both v4 preview fixtures omit hostCanonicalResult and add variant='not-produced', so they fail the still-operative input schema even though they fit the newly added sibling inputNotProduced description.

The truncation/artifactRefs required-name additions and the removal of invented preview digests are real improvements, but three simultaneous input descriptions leave opensip-sarif-golden.1 without one unambiguous validation rule and the native-map defect remains wholly unfixed.
blockers.impact: The claimed SARIFV3-B1 fold is false: a consumer cannot determine which input schema governs a golden, and two renderers can still choose different native location/related-location placements. OBL-2/OBL-3 remain non-deterministic.
blockers.minimumRepair: Actually replace nativeMappings with the claimed deterministic per-entry primary-location/related-location URI rule. Replace legacy goldenShape.input with one tagged union over inputNotProduced and inputProduced, or remove it and normatively designate exactly one variant schema; ensure both preview fixtures validate that rule. Retain the honest producedFixturesStanding without inventing a digest or identity recipe.

shouldFix.title: Splitting FC-NONAUTH left normative references pointing at a fixture ID that no longer exists
shouldFix.detail: The fixture split correctly makes the Coverage subcase INACTIVE on ID-DEP-S2 and keeps the termination/D9 subcase ACTIVE on ride:null. However, OBL-4 still claims it is answered at fixtureClasses.FC-NONAUTH, and requiredOutputFailure still distinguishes FC-OUTFAIL from FC-NONAUTH. No fixture with that exact ID exists in v4. These unchanged paths became dangling references as a semantic consequence of the rostered ID split.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Roster and update OBL-4 answeredAt and the required-output cross-reference to the exact FC-NONAUTH-TERM and FC-NONAUTH-COVERAGE IDs as appropriate.

obligationReview.reason: Preview SARIF applicability remains NONE and any later advertisement remains conditional on owner-recorded DR-006 closure.
The namespaced member map remains useful, but native URI placement is unchanged and opensip-sarif-golden.1 has mutually incompatible, unconnected input descriptions.

The no-digest preview records and required truncation/artifactRefs names are honest improvements, but those records do not validate the still-operative goldenShape.input and the native parity shape remains ambiguous.
The termination/D9 and Coverage negatives now have correct separate standings and rides, but OBL-4's answeredAt pointer still names the removed FC-NONAUTH ID.
The exact output-failure boundary is unchanged and correct; only its contrastive fixture reference still names the removed FC-NONAUTH ID.

The recorded COORD digest 12d192f7... reproduced from repository commit 2327cf89106e3c58a317bf8b570697f3505dbbb8. The live b9819d6e... file is that exact snapshot plus 7,012 appended bytes, so no finding rests on append-only drift.

measurements.check: Produced expected members and native map
measurements.result: expectedWhenProduced now names truncation and per-result artifactRefs, correctly distinguishes verdict ownership, and honestly parks produced fixtures. machineSurface.nativeMappings is nevertheless structurally unchanged from v3; relatedLocationUri occurs only in the repair claim, not the operative map.

FC-NONAUTH-TERM is ACTIVE on ride:null and FC-NONAUTH-COVERAGE is INACTIVE on ID-DEP-S2, correctly resolving the standing conflict. The exact old fixture ID remains in OBL-4 answeredAt and requiredOutputFailure.notARendererRefusal despite no longer existing.

A recursive v3-to-v4 comparison found 31 changed leaf paths and zero outside the closed roster in basedOn.method. The dangling references are semantic fallout at unchanged paths, not an unrostered byte edit.

The candidate remains not applied/do-not-seal, preview SARIF remains absent, G17 remains dropped, identity values remain opaque, and no implementation authority is asserted.
